notes: Inspired by an existing solution idea, manually developed.
aiExplanation: This function finds the **largest overlap** between two binary images by converting each image into a set of coordinates where 1s appear, then examining all possible **offsets** (translations) between them. For each pair of coordinates—one from each image—it calculates the **displacement vector** and tracks how many coordinate pairs produce the same displacement using a `Map`. This count represents how many 1s from one image would overlap with 1s in the other if shifted by that offset. The function returns the **maximum overlap count** found by trying all possible translations.
